title: Spirit of the Blooming Void
description: A pale blue-skinned humanoid figure with a partially exposed skull stands in a forest at night, head tilted upward. A swirling black smoke-like entity with glowing white eyes and sharp teeth emerges from the figure's head, transforming into a vibrant explosion of yellow, green, purple and red liquid color that splashes outward.
prompt: A surreal night scene featuring a pale blue humanoid with exposed skull standing in a dark forest with glowing flowers and roots. A black smoky demonic spirit with glowing white eyes and sharp teeth emerges from the figure's head and neck, swirling and transforming into a vibrant splash of yellow, green, purple and red liquid color exploding upwards. Red moon and dark trees in background, stylized digital painting with strong contrast.
